text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen announces that she will enter the Kikuka Sho, leaving Mejiro Ryan feeling unconfident about trying to match her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In defense of my racer, I tell McQueen that Ryan's muscles are the weapon she's going to use to defeat her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: McQueen is skeptical about this, but once she sees Ryan's polished physique, her mind is changed and she takes the challenge seriously.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Kikuka Sho, where the Mejiro family will finally clash, is fast approaching.
